description:
Job Description 
 ● Design logical Data Warehouse architecture and data model, implement physical Data Warehouse design (schema, indexes, partitions, etc.) 
 ● Design solutions for a high scale platform processing of large amounts of data 
 ● Assess and research current implementations of the platform and determine the course of action required to enhance the platform 
 ● Develop new Oracle, SQL Server, and MySQL database modules and code to support expansion of current oracle solution for business expansion. 
 ● Work towards expanding our current data marts to enable data mining in broader across all our databases. 
 ● Strong commitment to quality, documentation and engineering excellence 
 ● Strong communication skills, problem solving skills and adaptability 
 ● Experience in reverse engineering and understanding existing applications 
 ● Agile methodologies or iterative development processes 

 Technology experience 
 ● 5+ years of experience in systems development, including Data Warehouse development 
 ● 5+ Years of Oracle in Unix/Linux environment 
 ● Solid understanding of data warehousing architecture 
 ● High proficiency in designing and writing queries, stored procedures, packages and functions in Oracle 11g or 12c 
 ● Strong hands-on experience of scripting languages (Python, Shell or any equivalent language) is required 
 ● Hands-on experience with Object oriented programming with C/C++/Java is a nice to have 
 ● Background in payment processing industry or financial services industry is nice to have 
 Behavioral attributes 
 ● Ability to take ownership 
 ● Willingness to learn niche technologies based on role needs 
 ● Inclination to understand the business area 
 ● Must have excellent listening, communication and influencing skills. 
 Qualifications 
 ● Bachelors in Computer Science or equivalent 
 ● 5+ years of relevant experience
